method: Retained failures and their scope; existence or process exit is never promoted to scenario success. Actual code/data SHA remain in individual proofs.

items.observation: Initial local car replay reused an obsolete Y after a mesh change, yielding a zero-distance support refusal.
items.correction: Prepare actual current height and normal door completion before independent departure.

items.observation: Longitudinal road phase2m demonstrably regressed a narrow seam. Walking/car failures on that version are separately retained; the seam diagnosis does not establish every long-run failure cause.
items.correction: Restored original longitudinal4m; kept causal transverse refinement.

items.observation: Early synthetic-rig prototypes had dirty/end-of-run SHA labels and a near-zero final floating dt.
Empty native WebM attempts had no valid EBML header under load; some screenshots timed out.
items.correction: Retained originals/failures; native preroll waits for three actual RAF frames. No manual step or re-encoding.

items.observation: Two endurance launchers initially wrote the same output. Duplicate was terminated; original owner continued and rewrote its full in-memory monotonic journal.
items.correction: Unique exclusive output lock and ownerPID on subsequent sessions.

items.observation: The first mixed endurance driver kept stale lastMoved on car re-entry, repeatedly exiting/entering. Its1807s wall duration is not qualifying continuous exploration.
items.correction: Reset movement age on actual car entry, distinguish tile waiting from collision stall, and physically walk/return alongside the car.

items.observation: Original M26.4 car driver only invoked parking/walking after40km, omitting it after the intermediate80km arrival.
items.correction: Same normal posttrip protocol now applies to40 and80km; final80 records205.13m walking.

items.observation: A cold Angles departure failed at1539.90m with clear centre support. Late default parked-car placement is suspected, not proven from the failed trace which lacked its pose.
items.correction: Wait at the untouched actual spawn until the normal initial car appears; then4737.88m/3tiles physically complete. No actor or car assignment. This does not claim an engine race fixed.

items.observation: The first local-water shaft fitting used the already corrected X to recompute its stroke weight, so repeated fitting changed the phase and missed reliable water on return.
items.correction: Use immutable authoredX; idempotence test red/green; same angular bound and actual contact gate. Complete1km-follow/manual/dock/walk replay succeeds.

items.observation: Expanded bank indices changed when preflight was restricted to source-classified rivers. A graph/screen below1km is not a physical navigation failure.
items.correction: Keep both source selections and sector/OSM identities; separate graph plans from actual odometers.

items.observation: F8 initially sampled before world readiness, then the review build retained the default paused evidence frame. Neither failure is a production journey failure.
items.correction: Guard readiness, release native frame only in review mode, clone timed metric snapshots and reset FPS baseline while loading. Real F8/download check succeeds.

items.observation: Local file:// gallery navigation refused by browser administrative policy after desktop/mobile HTTP checks passed.
items.correction: Policy retained. Local HTTP and Internet-isolated loopback verified; local serving command delivered.
